---
title: "LIS' Rules for Citation"
---

Users of the LIS/LWS/LCS microdata are required to cite the data source in their list of references. As suggested by the Chicago Manual of Style (15th edition, 2007) pp 753-754 (17.358), LIS requests that authors use the following format.

## LIS microdata

Luxembourg Income Study (LIS) Database, (multiple countries; {include the dates of the interval during which microdata runs completed}). Luxembourg: LIS.

## LWS microdata

Luxembourg Wealth Study (LWS) Database, (multiple countries; {include the dates of the interval during which microdata runs completed}). Luxembourg: LIS.

## LCS microdata

Luxembourg Consumption Study (LCS) Database, (multiple countries; {include the dates of the interval during which microdata runs completed}). Luxembourg: LIS.
